title: LOWTIDE
description: Let the tide go out. A sleep ring told as one night on a moonlit tidal flat: scroll is the clock, five low tides tell the story.
stack: Next.js 16 · React 19 · Three.js WebGL · GSAP · Lenis · Tone.js

sections.title: 23:04, high tide (hook)
sections.summary: "Let the tide go out." — quiet line "A sleep ring for people who can't put the phone down."

sections.title: 00:40 (problem)
sections.summary: "The scroll doesn't end. The night does." Bioluminescent plankton (GPU particles, ~37k) swarm into sourced figures: **1 in 3** US adults sleep under seven hours (CDC MMWR 2016), **7h** minimum (CDC), **95%** use a screen in the hour before bed (National Sleep Foundation 2011).

sections.title: 02:15 (how it works)
sections.summary: "Three pools, read all night." Three rock pools: heart rate (rings at 60 bpm), skin temperature (water warms/cools over 8 s), breathing (a rim swells 12×/min).

sections.title: 03:50 (smart wake)
sections.summary: "We wake you on the outgoing tide." A post-process ink melt bleeds the frame while arriving and resolves at rest.

sections.title: 05:25 (proof)
sections.summary: three testimonials beside footprint trails pressed in wet sand; after the low tide the water returns and washes each trail away.

sections.title: 06:40 (signature)
sections.summary: "The moon, on your hand." The moon's reflection in the last pool ripples, bends into a ring outline, and a procedural titanium ring (lathe of a rounded-rectangle profile, `MeshPhysicalMaterial`, `RoomEnvironment`) rises out of the water. Specs and "$279 · no subscription" etched in the sand.

sections.title: 07:00 dawn (conversion)
sections.summary: "Your night": bedtime + wake time → a glowing tide line over the water (one dip per 90-min cycle, smart-wake marker), drag/arrow keys to walk it, "Keep your night" downloads a PNG; pre-order form (email, ring size 6–13, finish Moonstone / Tidewater / Driftwood) with a tide-wash success "See you at low tide."
